t: A small low-cost programmable drone from Robolink, coded with Blockly.
steps: Find the CoDrone Mini listing and check you are not looking at CoDrone EDU.
Check the current price at more than one seller.
Ask the seller what computers and apps the Mini needs.
Charge the battery and pair the drone with the remote.
Try a first flight in an open area.
Try Blockly with one student group.
